title: Resolution granting tax break for Gowanus Green housing, Brooklyn
summary: This resolution approves a real property tax exemption for the Gowanus Green A affordable housing project at Block 471, Lot 1 in Brooklyn under state housing finance law. The exemption can last up to 40 years and requires the project to be operated as affordable housing under a regulatory agreement with the city housing department. It can be terminated if the owner fails to comply with program requirements or transfers the property without approval.
